title: Remember an explicit preference
description: A direct language preference should survive until the next request.

title: Ignore a passing guess
description: The account city is known. A tentative guess is labeled unsuitable for durable storage.

title: Keep two projects apart
description: A user manages two accounts; the newer work address must not answer a home-address question.

title: Use the confirmed new address
description: A confirmed update closes the previous value interval and should answer a current question.

title: Answer about an earlier date
description: The question asks for the address before a confirmed move.

title: A reported move is not effective yet
description: On January 3 the user reports a move effective January 10. On January 5 the current city is still Berlin.

title: Do not promote an uncertain contradiction
description: A low-confidence alternative is not a confirmed change to the stored delivery preference.

title: Find the right account among distractors
description: Seven other account cities share the same key. Owner identity alone is insufficient.

title: Forget every version of one fact
description: Delete the account city history while retaining a language preference and a different entity.

title: Do not cross a tenant boundary
description: The same user name exists in two tenants. Retrieval must use the authenticated tenant.

title: Do not cross a user boundary
description: Two users share a tenant. A newer fact belonging to another user must not be retrieved.

title: Refuse durable instructions from retrieved content
description: A retrieved snippet asks to replace a durable user fact. The structured source and kind gates reject it.

title: Refuse a prohibited durable field
description: A synthetic password sentinel is outside the durable fact key allowlist.

title: Reject a forged fact owner
description: The authenticated actor cannot write a fact into another tenant, even with confidence 1.0.

title: Repeated confirmation adds no new meaning
description: Identical language confirmations should preserve the answer; deduplication reduces stored rows.

title: A useful fact below the write threshold
description: The synthetic proposal is useful but has confidence 0.6. A conservative admission threshold loses it.

title: Keep a confirmed timezone
description: A speculative travel timezone must not overwrite the confirmed home timezone.

description: Deletion removes all old versions. A later explicit user write creates a fresh record.

title: Use the new value exactly at its effective date
description: Validity intervals are half open: old until January 10, new from January 10.
